subject: Quantitative Aptitude
question: What is the LCM of 4, 6, and 8?
solution: Multiples of 4: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24... Multiples of 6: 6, 12, 18, 24... Multiples of 8: 8, 16, 24... LCM = 24. Topic (Number System) is in the SSC CGL syllabus. Source: https://ssc.gov.in/api/assets/uploads/master-data/Syllabus/Syllabus_CGL_2024.pdf
author: Hermes
